def sha(b):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def canonical(d):
    return (json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()

def save(name, d):
    with (OUT / name).open("xb") as f:
        f.write(canonical(d))
    (OUT / name).chmod(0o644)

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT)

def artifact(p):
    b = p.read_bytes()
    return {"path": str(p.relative_to(ROOT)), "byte_length": str(len(b)),
            "sha256": sha(b), "mode": format(p.stat().st_mode & 0o777, "04o")}

assert summary["post_status_porcelain"] == ""
tested = summary["head_and_tree"].split()
assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip() == tested[0]
for p in sorted(CHECKS.glob("*.json")):
    dest = OUT / "evidence" / p.name
    with dest.open("xb") as f:
        f.write(p.read_bytes())
    dest.chmod(0o644)

regression = json.loads((CHECKS / "11-regression.json").read_text())
parity_roots = sorted(set(re.findall(r"/tmp/aleph-duplicate-parity-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", regression["stdout"])))
retained = []
for original_root in parity_roots:
    source = Path(original_root)
    assert not source.is_symlink() and source.resolve() == source
    destination = OUT / "evidence/regression-duplicate-parity"
    destination.mkdir(mode=0o755)
    expected_names = {f"{i}-{v}.{stream}" for i in range(4)
                      for v in ["source", "runtime"] for stream in ["stdout", "stderr"]} | {"report.json"}
    assert {p.name for p in source.iterdir()} == expected_names
    for p in sorted(source.iterdir()):
        assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
        dest = destination / (p.name + ".raw")
        with dest.open("xb") as f:
            f.write(p.read_bytes())
        dest.chmod(0o644)
        retained.append({"original_path": str(p), "original_mode": format(p.stat().st_mode & 0o777, "04o"), "retained": artifact(dest)})
    for variant in ["source", "runtime"]:
        process_report = json.loads((source / ("3-" + variant + ".stdout")).read_text())
        process_root = Path(process_report["evidence_directory"])
        assert str(process_root).startswith("/tmp/aleph-duplicate-process-")
        assert not process_root.is_symlink() and process_root.resolve() == process_root
        for name in ["report.json", "progress.json", "seed.log", "static-relation-baseline.json"]:
            p = process_root / name
            assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
            dest = destination / (variant + "-process-" + name + ".raw")
            with dest.open("xb") as f:
                f.write(p.read_bytes())
            dest.chmod(0o644)
            retained.append({"original_path": str(p), "original_mode": format(p.stat().st_mode & 0o777, "04o"), "retained": artifact(dest)})

def tree(rev):
    result = {}
    for row in git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", rev).split(b"\0"):
        if not row:
            continue
        meta, path = row.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, oid = meta.decode().split()
        result[path.decode()] = {"mode": mode, "kind": kind, "git_object": oid}
    return result
